thread:
maria_sales: Hey team — Acme POC hit a blocker when they try to provision users. They run on-prem ADFS + SCIM and their bulk import (10k users) gets 413 or intermittent 429s. POC kickoff is tomorrow, need a short-term workaround so they can demo.

sam_se: Do we have the raw request size and response headers? 413 usually means the fronting proxy (nginx/ADFS proxy) rejected it. 429 points to rate limiting somewhere.

anita_devops: Customer sent snippets — they POST a JSON array of 10k users to /scim/v2/Users in a single request. Their edge proxy caps body size and also rate-limits long requests. Suggest chunking + backoff.

kevin_security: Also confirm auth method. If they use rotating tokens/session SAML assertions for the service account, long requests could fail mid-flight. Are they using client-credentials/service account?

maria_sales: They said service account via client_credentials but the token rotates every 30m. They retried and still saw 413. Ops asked if we can provide a hosted-scoped API key for provisioning during the POC to avoid their proxy for a quick demo — short-lived and watchlisted.

sam_se: We can issue a scoped hosted key (provisioning-only) with expiry and IP allowlist. For Dedicated/Private we'd recommend doing the sync from inside their VPC or via our SCIM relay. For tomorrow's demo a hosted key is fine but needs security signoff.

kevin_security: I approve a 48h scoped key with audit logging enabled. Must be IP restricted to their jumpbox and marked as provisioning-only. I'll create the approval in the ticket.

anita_devops: Immediate customer-facing mitigation: split into chunks of 500 users per request and implement exponential backoff for 429/5xx. Example curl they can use: 

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/scim/v2/Users \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"Resources": [ ... up to 500 users ... ] }'
```

anita_devops: Also recommend they increase proxy body size or configure streaming JSON ingestion on their side if they want single-shot imports.

maria_sales: Can we also get eng-infra to look at logs from our gateway in case the 413 is coming from our edge? @ingress_bot can you surface recent gateway 413/413-rate logs for their tenant id acme-inc?

ingress_bot: Ticket created: INC-4521. Gateway logs pulled (last 24h) — majority of 413 responses originate from customer proxy, not our edge. Snapshot uploaded to INC-4521.

sam_se: I'll take the escalation. Plan: 1) issue 48h provisioning key (kevin to OK) 2) share chunking curl + backoff with customer 3) quick config guide for Dedicated/Private options 4) deep-dive call at 16:00 PST if customer still blocked.

maria_sales: Thanks — I'll notify the customer and get their jumpbox IP for allowlisting.

kevin_security: Posted approval in INC-4521 and added IP/expiry constraints. Audit logging enabled.

anita_devops: Follow-up notes for POC: if they plan repeated large syncs, recommend using our SCIM relay inside their network (Private) or breaking imports into delta updates instead of full 10k pushes.

maria_sales: Great — running with that. Will update thread after the demo. :thumbsup:
